title: Inspect and extend: Agree on a small language of remote-control events
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/protocol.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve event union, json encoding, decoding, bounds, and unknown-event rejection.
problem: Two programs need to agree on message words. Learn the event shapes, then trace validation and JSON encoding on the phone and decoding at the relay. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/protocol.ts` and the related project files: src/protocol.ts; server/relay.js; test/protocol.test.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to event union, json encoding, decoding, bounds, and unknown-event rejection.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Validation narrows malformed input but does not authenticate a sender.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Two programs need to agree on message words. Learn the event shapes, then trace validation and JSON encoding on the phone and decoding at the relay.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/protocol.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
